        openapi
      • openapi(registry: OpenApiRegistry; options: OpenApiOptions = defaultOpenApiOptions()): AsyncMiddleware

OpenAPI / Swagger spec generation middleware. Auto-generates OpenAPI 3.0 spec from registered routes and serves Swagger UI.Return OpenAPI options with default API info and doc paths.Create a new OpenApiRegistry for collecting route docs.Register or update a RouteDoc for a httpMethod and pattern pair.Register a RouteDoc for a GET route.Register a RouteDoc for a POST route.Register a RouteDoc for a PUT route.Register a RouteDoc for a DELETE route.Register a RouteDoc for a PATCH route.NOTE: The returned middleware is NOT thread-safe: the spec cache is closure-local. In runThreaded mode, create one instance per thread, or prefer runCluster()/runAuto() (separate processes) for shared use.
